global: A bowl of spicy ramen broth, rich and red, cradles noodles, spinach, and a creamy center topped with grated cheese and herbs. Served in a white bowl on a wooden table, warm lighting highlights the vibrant, appetizing dish.

regions.background: Light brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, showing natural wood surface details.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and faint orange residue along inner edge.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, green vegetables, and grated cheese topping, garnished with herbs.
